title: India's Core Sector Growth Hits 13-Month High Of 10.9 Per Cent In October, Driven By Coal, Iron Ore And Electricity
dek: India's core sector growth reached a 13-month high of 10.9 per cent in October, led by coal, iron ore and electricity, according to Swarajya.
summary: Swarajya reports that growth in India's core sector rose to 10.9 per cent in October, a 13-month high. The headline credits coal, iron ore and electricity for the increase. The excerpt does not give figures for steel or for individual components.
keyFacts: Core sector growth of 10.9 per cent in October
Coal, iron ore and electricity led growth
whyItMatters: Strong coal and iron ore output points to firm activity in steelmaking raw materials, which could support domestic steel production.
implications: Better availability of iron ore and coal may help moderate input costs for Indian steelmakers. Readers should watch the steel component once detailed data are available.
